```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(glmnet)
library(randomForest)
library(pROC)
library(limma)

set.seed(42)
```

```{r loading data}
counts <- read.csv("data/miRNA_countmatrix.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
meta   <- read.csv("data/sample_info.csv",       row.names = 1)
cand   <- read.csv("results/ml_candidate_miRNAs.csv")

meta <- meta[colnames(counts), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(all(rownames(meta) == colnames(counts)))

meta$condition <- factor(meta$condition)
meta$condition <- relevel(meta$condition, ref = "Healthy Control")
```

```{r Rebuild dds and normalise, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts,
  colData   = meta,
  design    = ~ dataset + condition
)

keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 3
dds  <- dds[keep, ]
dds  <- DESeq(dds)

vsd        <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds, blind = FALSE)
vst_mat    <- assay(vsd)
vst_counts <- removeBatchEffect(vst_mat, batch = vsd$dataset)
```

```{r prepare ml matrix}
cand_ids <- intersect(cand$miRNA, rownames(vst_counts))
stopifnot(length(cand_ids) > 0)

sig_expr <- vst_counts[cand_ids, , drop = FALSE]
expr_ml  <- as.data.frame(t(sig_expr))
expr_ml$Group <- factor(meta$condition, levels = c("Schizophrenia", "Healthy Control"))

miRNA_mapping <- data.frame(
  Original_ID = setdiff(colnames(expr_ml), "Group"),
  R_Safe_ID   = make.names(setdiff(colnames(expr_ml), "Group"))
)
write.csv(miRNA_mapping, "results/miRNA_ID_mapping.csv", row.names = FALSE)

colnames(expr_ml) <- make.names(colnames(expr_ml))

cat("Total samples:", nrow(expr_ml), "| Candidate features:", ncol(expr_ml) - 1, "\n")
```
```{r cv loop, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(42)
folds <- createMultiFolds(expr_ml$Group, k = 5, times = 10)

# Storage for out-of-fold predictions
all_preds_lr <- data.frame(obs = character(), prob = numeric())
all_preds_rf <- data.frame(obs = character(), prob = numeric())
all_preds_la <- data.frame(obs = character(), prob = numeric())

# record and Save everytime  mirna occurs in a fold

all_fold_features <- list() 

for (fold_name in names(folds)) {

  train_idx <- folds[[fold_name]]
  cv_train  <- expr_ml[ train_idx, ]
  cv_test   <- expr_ml[-train_idx, ]

  # 1. Random Forest importance
  rf_inner <- randomForest(Group ~ ., data = cv_train, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE)
  rf_imp   <- importance(rf_inner)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
  top_rf   <- names(sort(rf_imp, decreasing = TRUE))[1:min(10, length(rf_imp))]

  # 2. LASSO feature selection
  x_cv_train  <- data.matrix(cv_train[, setdiff(colnames(cv_train), "Group")])
  y_cv_train  <- cv_train$Group
  la_cv_inner <- cv.glmnet(x_cv_train, y_cv_train, family = "binomial", alpha = 1,
                            nfolds = min(5, min(table(y_cv_train))))
  coef_mat    <- as.matrix(coef(la_cv_inner, s = "lambda.min"))
  lasso_feats <- setdiff(rownames(coef_mat)[coef_mat[, 1] != 0], "(Intercept)")

  # 3. Intersection;
  fold_features <- intersect(top_rf, lasso_feats)
  if (length(fold_features) < 3) {
    fold_features <- unique(c(top_rf[1:min(5, length(top_rf))], lasso_feats))
    fold_features <- fold_features[1:min(10, length(fold_features))] #fallback to reduce overfitting
  }

  # Recording which features were used in this fold
  all_fold_features[[fold_name]] <- fold_features

  cv_train_sub <- cv_train[, c("Group", fold_features), drop = FALSE]
  cv_test_sub  <- cv_test[,  c("Group", fold_features), drop = FALSE]

  lr_prob <- tryCatch({
    lr_fit <- glm(Group ~ ., data = cv_train_sub, family = binomial)
    p <- predict(lr_fit, newdata = cv_test_sub, type = "response")
    if (levels(cv_train$Group)[2] != "Schizophrenia") p <- 1 - p
    p
  }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(cv_test_sub)))

  #Random Forest
  rf_fit  <- randomForest(Group ~ ., data = cv_train_sub, ntree = 500)
  rf_mat  <- predict(rf_fit, cv_test_sub, type = "prob")
  rf_prob <- if ("Schizophrenia" %in% colnames(rf_mat)) rf_mat[, "Schizophrenia"] else rf_mat[, 2]

  #LASSO Logistic Regression
  la_prob <- tryCatch({
    x_tr_sub <- data.matrix(cv_train_sub[, fold_features])
    x_te_sub <- data.matrix(cv_test_sub[,  fold_features])
    la_fit   <- cv.glmnet(x_tr_sub, cv_train_sub$Group, family = "binomial", alpha = 1,
                          nfolds = min(5, min(table(cv_train_sub$Group))))
    p_raw    <- predict(la_fit, x_te_sub, s = "lambda.min", type = "response")[, 1]
    if (levels(cv_train$Group)[2] != "Schizophrenia") p_raw <- 1 - p_raw
    p_raw
  }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(cv_test_sub)))

  #Accumulate predictions
  obs_labels   <- as.character(cv_test$Group)
  all_preds_lr <- rbind(all_preds_lr, data.frame(obs = obs_labels, prob = lr_prob))
  all_preds_rf <- rbind(all_preds_rf, data.frame(obs = obs_labels, prob = rf_prob))
  all_preds_la <- rbind(all_preds_la, data.frame(obs = obs_labels, prob = la_prob))
}

cat("CV complete")
```

```{r cv-auc}
compute_pooled_roc <- function(preds_df, model_name) {
  valid   <- !is.na(preds_df$prob)
  obs_f   <- factor(preds_df$obs[valid], levels = c("Healthy Control", "Schizophrenia"))
  probs   <- preds_df$prob[valid]

  roc_obj <- roc(obs_f, probs, levels = c("Healthy Control", "Schizophrenia"),
                 direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)
  auc_val <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
  ci_val  <- ci.auc(roc_obj, method = "delong")

  cat(sprintf("%-28s | AUC = %.2f  |  95%% CI [%.2f - %.2f]\n",
              model_name, auc_val, ci_val[1], ci_val[3]))

  list(roc = roc_obj, auc = auc_val, ci = ci_val, name = model_name)
}

cat("=== Cross-Validated AUC-ROC (5-fold x 10 repeats, n = 38) ===\n")
roc_lr <- compute_pooled_roc(all_preds_lr, "Logistic Regression")
roc_rf <- compute_pooled_roc(all_preds_rf, "Random Forest")
roc_la <- compute_pooled_roc(all_preds_la, "LASSO Logistic Regression")
```

```{r roc-plot}
cols <- c(
  "Logistic Regression"       = "red",
  "Random Forest"             = "green",
  "LASSO Logistic Regression" = "blue"
)

# Saving to file first
png("plots/roc_curve_final.png", width = 6, height = 6, units = "in", res = 600)
plot(roc_lr$roc, col = cols["Logistic Regression"], lwd = 2.5,
     main = "Cross-Validated ROC Curves", cex.main = 0.95)
plot(roc_rf$roc, col = cols["Random Forest"],             lwd = 2.5, add = TRUE)
plot(roc_la$roc, col = cols["LASSO Logistic Regression"], lwd = 2.5, add = TRUE)
abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "grey60", lwd = 1.2)
legend("bottomright",
       legend = c(
         sprintf("Logistic Regression   AUC = %.2f (%.2f-%.2f)",
                 roc_lr$auc, roc_lr$ci[1], roc_lr$ci[3]),
         sprintf("Random Forest         AUC = %.2f (%.2f-%.2f)",
                 roc_rf$auc, roc_rf$ci[1], roc_rf$ci[3]),
         sprintf("LASSO Log. Reg.       AUC = %.2f (%.2f-%.2f)",
                 roc_la$auc, roc_la$ci[1], roc_la$ci[3])
       ),
       col = unname(cols), lwd = 2.5, bty = "n", cex = 0.82)
dev.off()

plot(roc_lr$roc, col = cols["Logistic Regression"], lwd = 2.5,
     main = "Cross-Validated ROC Curves", cex.main = 0.95)
plot(roc_rf$roc, col = cols["Random Forest"],             lwd = 2.5, add = TRUE)
plot(roc_la$roc, col = cols["LASSO Logistic Regression"], lwd = 2.5, add = TRUE)
abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "grey60", lwd = 1.2)
legend("bottomright",
       legend = c(
         sprintf("Logistic Regression   AUC = %.2f (%.2f-%.2f)",
                 roc_lr$auc, roc_lr$ci[1], roc_lr$ci[3]),
         sprintf("Random Forest         AUC = %.2f (%.2f-%.2f)",
                 roc_rf$auc, roc_rf$ci[1], roc_rf$ci[3]),
         sprintf("LASSO Log. Reg.       AUC = %.2f (%.2f-%.2f)",
                 roc_la$auc, roc_la$ci[1], roc_la$ci[3])
       ),
       col = unname(cols), lwd = 2.5, bty = "n", cex = 0.82)
```
```{r summary-table}
summary_df <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Logistic Regression", "Random Forest", "LASSO Logistic Regression"),
  CV_AUC      = round(c(roc_lr$auc, roc_rf$auc, roc_la$auc), 3),
  CV_CI_lower = round(c(roc_lr$ci[1], roc_rf$ci[1], roc_la$ci[1]), 3),
  CV_CI_upper = round(c(roc_lr$ci[3], roc_rf$ci[3], roc_la$ci[3]), 3)
)

knitr::kable(
  summary_df,
  col.names = c("Model", "CV AUC", "95% CI lower", "95% CI upper")
)

write.csv(summary_df, "results/model_performance_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r final panel}

# Count selection frequency across all 50 folds
feature_votes <- sort(table(unlist(all_fold_features)), decreasing = TRUE)

cat("Feature selection frequency across 50 folds:\n")
print(feature_votes)

# Keep miRNAs selected in >= 50% of folds (stable across repeats)
n_folds_total  <- length(folds)                         # 50
stability_threshold <- 0.50                             
stable_features <- names(feature_votes)[
  feature_votes >= stability_threshold * n_folds_total
]

if (length(stable_features) < 3) {
  stable_features <- names(feature_votes)[1:min(5, length(feature_votes))]
  cat("Using top-5 most frequently selected features\n")
}

cat("\nFinal biomarker panel (selected in >=", stability_threshold * 100,
    "% of folds):", length(stable_features), "miRNAs\n")
print(stable_features)

# Map back to original identifire
published_true_ids <- miRNA_mapping$Original_ID[
  miRNA_mapping$R_Safe_ID %in% stable_features
]
cat("\n Original identifiers:\n")
print(published_true_ids)

write.csv(data.frame(miRNA = published_true_ids),
          "results/Final_Signature_IDs.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r feature-stability-plot}
# Visualise how stable each miRNA's selection was across folds

votes_df <- data.frame(
  miRNA      = names(feature_votes),
  Folds      = as.integer(feature_votes),
  Stable     = names(feature_votes) %in% stable_features
)

p_votes <- ggplot(votes_df, aes(x = reorder(miRNA, Folds),
                                 y = Folds,
                                 fill = Stable)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = stability_threshold * n_folds_total,
             linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = stability_threshold * n_folds_total + 1,
           label = paste0(stability_threshold * 100, "% threshold"),
           hjust = 0, size = 3.2, colour = "grey30") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "steelblue", "FALSE" = "grey70"),
                    labels = c("TRUE" = "stable",
                               "FALSE" = "Not stable"),
                    name = NULL) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Feature Selection Stability Across 50 CV Folds",
       x = NULL, y = "No. of folds selected out of 50") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom")

print(p_votes)
ggsave("plots/feature_stability.png", p_votes, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```
```{r save-final-candidates}

final_candidates <- data.frame(
  R_Safe_ID   = votes_df$miRNA,
  Original_ID = miRNA_mapping$Original_ID[
                  match(votes_df$miRNA, miRNA_mapping$R_Safe_ID)],
  Folds_Selected = votes_df$Folds,
  Pct_Folds      = round(votes_df$Folds / n_folds_total * 100, 1)
)

write.csv(final_candidates, "results/Final_Candidate_miRNAs.csv", row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(final_candidates,
             caption = "miRNA selection stability across 50 CV folds")
```
